subject: Flowdown amendment: downstream vendor onboarding & data access checklist
messages:
From: Dina Morales <dina.morales@acmetech.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, procurement@acmetech.com
Date: 2025-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Notice: addition of CloudStream Solutions as downstream vendor / initial documentation

Hi Kimberly —

Quick heads-up: Acme is planning to engage a new subcontractor, CloudStream Solutions, to provide metrics forwarding and aggregated logging to our analytics pipeline. Per the MSA flow-down terms and our order form, we wanted to notify Redwood and request your consent for the subprocessor addition.

What we are including now:
- Declared subprocessor list (attached): Acme_Declared_Subprocessors_20251201.csv
- CloudStream DPA (attached): CloudStream_DPA.pdf
- Link to Acme SOC 2 Type II report (see attachments list)

Key points for Redwood to confirm:
1) Acceptable security evidence (SOC 2 / penetration test summary, encryption at rest/in transit).
2) Any data categories we should explicitly limit in the flowdown (PI, account identifiers, full request/response bodies).
3) Audit / inspection rights requested by Redwood and whether a 30-day notice window is acceptable.
4) If Redwood requires an amended order form or signed addendum, we can push a DocuSign flow once we have your legal redline.

Can you review and advise on next steps? If helpful, we can schedule a short triage call — Dina and our vendor ops lead are available Thursday or Friday this week.

Thanks,
Dina Morales
Head of Vendor Ops — Acme Technology
D: +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Acme_Declared_Subprocessors_20251201.csv, CloudStream_DPA.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Dina Morales <dina.morales@acmetech.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-12-01T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Notice: addition of CloudStream Solutions as downstream vendor / initial documentation

Dina — thanks for the notification and the attachments. Quick read-through and initial asks from our side:

Summary of what we need to triage right away:
- SOC 2 Type II report (pdf or link) and the date range that report covers.
- Confirmation CloudStream will be bound by the same DPA terms as Acme (prefer attach or confirm DPA flowdown).
- Short data-flow diagram (one page) showing which data elements CloudStream will receive/retain and retention windows.
- Confirmation of encryption at rest and in transit and key management (who holds keys for aggregated logs).

Operational asks:
- Please highlight any subprocessor activity that will include customer-derived content (requests/responses) vs. aggregate telemetry only. If there will be content-level access, we will need a more thorough scope and likely an Order Form amendment.
- If you intend to accept audit rights, give a proposed process (e.g., remote evidence within 30 days, on-site only for escalations).

I've looped in Priyom (security) and Jonas (legal) — Priyom can triage the technical evidence; Jonas, please see below for legal redline needs.

We can do a 30-min call on Friday 12/5 10:00-10:30 PT if that works for your team. Otherwise, a DocuSign route for an amended order form is fine once legal alignment is complete.

- Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Attachment: requested_evidence_checklist.xlsx (sent inline)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Dina Morales <dina.morales@acmetech.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-12-02T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Notice: addition of CloudStream Solutions as downstream vendor / initial documentation

Kimberly / Dina —

Thanks for the packet. I reviewed the CloudStream DPA and Acme's declared list. High-level legal items we need to address before consent:

1) Narrow the flowdown scope in the order form amendment: we should explicitly enumerate prohibited categories (e.g., full user prompt content, billing payment card data) and limit retention for any customer content to the minimum necessary (preferably <90 days for logs unless required).
2) Contractual audit rights: we are open to remote evidence and secure portal delivery. If Acme requires on-site audits, we need language limiting those to material incidents and with at least 30 days notice.
3) Subprocessor contractual parity: CloudStream must accept materially the same security obligations as Acme (encryption, breach notification, subprocess flowdown). If CloudStream's DPA is materially different, we need an amendment or a tri-party attestation.
4) Liability/indemnity: ask Acme to add a short flowdown clause requiring CloudStream indemnify for breaches caused by its processing activities (we can accept cap consistent with the existing order form).

I've attached a proposed redline to the existing Order Form that: (a) inserts a limited subprocessor clause referencing CloudStream by name, (b) narrows retention and data categories, and (c) includes audit process language. See attached: OrderForm_Amendment_Redline.pdf

Please confirm whether Acme can: (i) provide SOC 2 Type II artifacts to our secure intake site, (ii) get CloudStream to sign the attached DPA (or confirm equivalent), and (iii) accept the 30-day notice audit window.

If Acme can meet those, legal is prepared to approve and Kimberly can sign the DocuSign amendment. Happy to join a triage call Friday as well.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Attachment: OrderForm_Amendment_Redline.pdf

On Dec 1, 2025 at 09:12, Dina Morales <dina.morales@acmetech.com> wrote:
> Hi Kimberly —
> 
> Quick heads-up: Acme is planning to engage a new subcontractor, CloudStream Solutions...
From: Dina Morales <dina.morales@acmetech.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmetech.com
Date: 2025-12-03T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Notice: addition of CloudStream Solutions as downstream vendor / initial documentation

Kimberly / Jonas —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the proposed redline. Quick responses to the bullets below and what's attached:

- SOC 2 Type II: we uploaded the report and the SOC2 summary to a secure link (Acme_SOC2_TypeII_Link.txt attached with access URL and one-time token). Report date: coverage period 2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30.
- CloudStream DPA: attached (CloudStream_DPA.pdf). We confirmed with CloudStream that they will sign the same DPA or a tri-party attestation; they are willing to sign the attached DPA and accept audit rights as described.
- Data flow: CloudStream will only receive aggregated metrics and hashed identifiers for dedup purposes; they will not receive raw request/response bodies. See short data-flow note in the DocuSign packet.
- Audit rights: CloudStream accepts remote evidence via secure portal and agrees to on-site only if there's a verified material incident; they accept a 30-day notice for routine audits.

DocuSign: we prepared an amendment packet and started a DocuSign envelope for the Order Form amendment. Link: https://app.docusign.com/ACME-OrderForm-Amendment-239182 (also in related_links).

Next steps we propose:
1) Jonas — please confirm final redline acceptance or any last edits by EOD Monday (12/08).
2) Kimberly — if legal OK, please countersign via DocuSign and we will execute on our side.
3) Priyom — if you want evidence staged to your intake portal, let us know the secure upload instructions and token expiry window.

We can join Friday's triage if you want to walk through the redline live — otherwise we can proceed asynchronously.

Thanks,
Dina Morales
Head of Vendor Ops — Acme Technology

Attachments: Acme_SOC2_TypeII_Link.txt, CloudStream_DPA.pdf
